name: BV-AVD (Brentuximab vedotin + Doxorubicin + Vinblastine + Dacarbazine)

biomarkers.CD30: expressed on Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (intrinsic to classical Hodgkin lymphoma; not a separate testing gate in this setting)
biomarkers.note: Brentuximab vedotin is a CD30-directed antibody-drug conjugate. In classical Hodgkin lymphoma the Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are characteristically CD30 positive, so CD30 is intrinsic to the diagnosis rather than an added eligibility gate (unlike CD30-directed therapy in T-cell lymphomas, where CD30 positivity is the gate). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hodgkin Lymphoma, v2.2026.

treatmentSetting: primary therapy for classical Hodgkin lymphoma (advanced-stage III to IV; also studied in early-stage unfavorable disease per BREACH)
lineOfTherapy: first-line (primary) therapy; BV-AVD is a listed primary systemic therapy option (requires G-CSF primary prophylaxis)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: previously untreated classical Hodgkin lymphoma (advanced stage III to IV)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, HODG-B (Principles of Systemic Therapy), line 1925: BV-AVD + G-CSF (Brentuximab-vedotin/Doxorubicin/Vinblastine/Dacarbazine); BREACH early-stage unfavorable reference (line 1233)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: primary G-CSF prophylaxis required with BV-AVD
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, HODG-B line 1925 (BV-AVD + G-CSF, footnote h)

drugs.name: Brentuximab vedotin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: VERIFY: BV-AVD (ECHELON-1) brentuximab dose 1.2 mg/kg every 2 weeks is NOT printed in the provided extracts. DeVita Table 10.1 (line 20811) prints brentuximab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks, maximum dose per 100 kg, for refractory Hodgkin lymphoma and refractory systemic ALCL, which is a DIFFERENT dose/schedule from the frontline BV-AVD regimen.

drugs.notes: Dose set to VERIFY. In the frontline A+AVD (BV-AVD, ECHELON-1) regimen brentuximab vedotin is given 1.2 mg/kg IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle (every 2 weeks), but that dose/schedule is not in the provided DeVita/Harrison extracts. The only grounded brentuximab dose (DeVita Table 10.1, line 20811) is 1.8 mg/kg every 3 weeks for refractory disease, which must NOT be substituted here. Body-weight dosing is capped at 100 kg (line 20812). CD30-directed ADC. Verify the 1.2 mg/kg every-2-week frontline dose against the source before activation.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Hodgkin lymphoma chapter, line 330594 (ABVD x4 vs x2 adds 100 mg/m2 doxorubicin, i.e. 50 mg/m2 per 28-day cycle, 25 mg/m2 per dose on days 1 and 15); AVD is ABVD with bleomycin omitted, doxorubicin dose unchanged (ABVD or AVD referenced line 29416).

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 330594. Doxorubicin 25 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 (the AVD/ABVD anthracycline dose; AVD omits bleomycin only). Anthracycline: track cumulative lifetime dose (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2).

drugs.name: vinBLAStine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Table 10.1 (antineoplastic drug reference), Vinblastine entry, line 20773: 6 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 as part of ABVD (same vinblastine component in AVD).

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., Table 10.1, line 20773. vinBLAStine 6 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15. ISMP tall-man vinBLAStine.

drugs.name: Dacarbazine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: VERIFY: dacarbazine AVD/ABVD dose not printed in the provided DeVita/Harrison extracts (dacarbazine doses found are melanoma-specific). Days 1 and 15 follow the shared AVD q28/q2wk schedule confirmed for vinblastine (line 20773).

drugs.notes: Dose set to VERIFY. Commonly cited AVD dacarbazine dose is 375 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15, but no source locator appears in the provided extracts. Verify numeric dose before activation.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: dacarbazine is highly emetogenic; give antiemetic prophylaxis before each cycle.

supportiveCare: G-CSF: primary prophylaxis is REQUIRED with BV-AVD (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hodgkin Lymphoma v2.2026, HODG-B line 1925, footnote h).

Brentuximab vedotin: monitor for peripheral neuropathy; hold/reduce for grade 2 or higher; avoid concurrent bleomycin (excess pulmonary toxicity with brentuximab, which is why AVD, not ABVD, is used with brentuximab).
Antiemetics: dacarbazine highly emetogenic; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.

monitoring: CBC with differential before each dose
peripheral neuropathy assessment each visit (brentuximab vedotin and vinblastine)
cumulative anthracycline dose tracking (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2)

doseModificationRules.text: Reduce or hold brentuximab vedotin for grade 2 or higher peripheral neuropathy per labeling; clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Table 10.1 vinblastine (line 20773) and brentuximab vedotin (lines 20811 to 20812, refractory-disease dose/schedule); Hodgkin chapter doxorubicin cumulative-dose statement (line 330594); ABVD or AVD reference (line 29416)

guideline.locator: HODG-B Principles of Systemic Therapy, line 1925: BV-AVD + G-CSF (Brentuximab-vedotin/Doxorubicin/Vinblastine/Dacarbazine); BREACH early-stage unfavorable reference (line 1233)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for BV-AVD (brentuximab vedotin + AVD; ECHELON-1) in classical Hodgkin lymphoma (#75). Doxorubicin 25 mg/m2 days 1 and 15 is grounded via the DeVita statement that ABVD x4 adds 100 mg/m2 of doxorubicin over ABVD x2 (line 330594); vinBLAStine 6 mg/m2 days 1 and 15 to DeVita Table 10.1 (line 20773). Two doses are set to VERIFY: (1) brentuximab vedotin, because the frontline BV-AVD dose (1.2 mg/kg every 2 weeks) is not printed in the provided extracts and must not be confused with the grounded refractory-disease dose (1.8 mg/kg every 3 weeks, Table 10.1 line 20811); and (2) dacarbazine, because no AVD/ABVD dacarbazine dose locator appears in the extracts. Regimen identity and the mandatory G-CSF primary prophylaxis are grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hodgkin Lymphoma v2.2026 (HODG-B, line 1925). Bleomycin is intentionally omitted (AVD) because concurrent brentuximab and bleomycin cause excess pulmonary toxicity. ISMP tall-man applied (DOXOrubicin, vinBLAStine); brentuximab body-weight dosing capped at 100 kg (line 20812); anthracycline cumulative cap 450/550 mg/m2. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
